The use of homeopathic remedies as first-line treatments for septic shock is not supported by evidence-based clinical guidelines. Conventional management of septic shock prioritizes antibiotics, fluids, vasopressors, and corticosteroids [Surviving Sepsis Campaign, 2023]. No homeopathic remedy has been validated in rigorous clinical trials for this life-threatening condition. Alternative therapies should not replace evidence-based interventions in septic shock.
